mapping.summary: Restricts which G/L accounts each user can see and type, without breaking posting.
claims: Per-user allowed or blocked G/L account filters using standard filter syntax
Filters the G/L account list, chart of accounts, account card and G/L entries
Posting still works when a document touches a restricted account
Stops restricted accounts being typed on journal, purchase and sales lines; can be turned off per user
Logs every blocked attempt with user, account, source and time
Preview the chart of accounts as a chosen user sees it
Bulk setup through an Excel matrix of accounts by user
Job queue and background posting are never blocked
API/OData, Edit in Excel, config packages and direct reports are not filtered
Needs BC online version 27 or later
Licensed per user with no trial
